target.name: Epsilon Indi B
target.description: A pair of brown dwarfs (objects too small to shine like stars) orbiting each other and the star Epsilon Indi, about 12 light-years away.

photometry_stream.method: Quick-look aperture photometry (circle radius 2.0 px, sky ring 4.0–7.0 px) using the nominal pixel area, so fluxes are approximate. For science-grade spectra, use IRSA's Spectrophotometry Tool: https://irsa.ipac.caltech.edu/applications/spherex/tool-spectrophotometry

flags.name: TRANSIENT
flags.label: Brief glitch during readout (e.g. a cosmic-ray hit)

flags.name: OVERFLOW
flags.label: Too bright: the pixel overflowed

flags.name: SUR_ERROR
flags.label: Error while the spacecraft processed this pixel

flags.name: NONFUNC
flags.label: Dead pixel (never usable)

flags.name: DICHROIC
flags.label: Low sensitivity here because of the telescope's colour-splitting mirror

flags.name: MISSING_DATA
flags.label: Data lost before reaching Earth

flags.name: HOT
flags.label: Hot pixel (always reads too bright)

flags.name: COLD
flags.label: Cold pixel (reads too faint)

flags.name: FULLSAMPLE
flags.description: Pixel full sample history is available
flags.label: Full readout history saved (information only)

flags.name: PHANMISS
flags.label: 'Phantom' correction not applied

flags.name: NONLINEAR
flags.description: Nonlinearity correction cannot be applied reliably
flags.label: Too bright to correct reliably

flags.name: PERSIST
flags.label: Afterglow from a bright source seen earlier

flags.name: OUTLIER
flags.label: Value looks unusual compared with its neighbours

flags.name: CROSSTALK
flags.label: Echo of a bright pixel elsewhere on the detector

flags.name: SOURCE
flags.description: Pixel mapped to a known source
flags.label: A known star or galaxy is here (information only)

flags.name: GHOST
flags.description: Affected by a bright source inside the exposure
flags.label: Reflection of a bright star in this image

flags.name: GHOST_FPA
flags.description: Affected by a bright source on another detector
flags.label: Reflection of a bright star on another detector

flags.name: GHOST_EXT
flags.description: Pixel affected by a bright source outside FOV
flags.label: Glare from a bright star outside the image

flags.name: STREAK
flags.label: Streak, e.g. a satellite crossing

flags.name: BLOOM
flags.description: Pixel part of a bloom artifact
flags.label: Charge bleeding from a saturated star

flags.name: SNOWBALL
flags.description: Pixel part of a snowball artifact
flags.label: 'Snowball' artifact (a large cosmic-ray splash)

flags.name: HALO
flags.description: Pixel part of a transient halo
flags.label: Short-lived halo artifact
